messages.subject: Enjoyed Yesterday's Conversation
messages.body:
Good Afternoon Lonnie,

I hope you are doing well. I just wanted to send a brief email thanking you
for the time you spent with me on the phone yesterday. I enjoyed learning
more about your background as well as gaining additional insight into
Houlihan LA. I look forward to hearing any potential updates from
your office soon. Have a good weekend.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman
messages.body_captured_reason: Re-fetched from Gmail on 2026-09-02 (WS9 Phase A §2.9). The Stage A capture recorded this message metadata-only with an EMPTY To line and the thread id in place of the message id, which detached it from Lonnie entirely and made her row read Not emailed. The To line, message id and body above are the real message.

capture_note: Corrected 2026-09-02. The interview happened Friday 2024-02-09 at 10:00 PST (12:00 in Austin) and this thank-you went the next afternoon, Saturday 2024-02-10 at 15:06 Austin time — which is why it says both 'yesterday' and 'have a good weekend'. The two dates the brief flagged as not obviously agreeing do agree; the UTC timestamp (21:06Z) simply reads as a different day than Jon's own clock did. Lonnie is reachable ONLY through this message: she is named in Sara's confirmation in body text alone, and referral discovery is headers-only (rules §8, D15).
